label: Ocean chlorophyll-a (MODIS Aqua)
verdict: Ocean chlorophyll-a (MODIS Aqua) (all months, 2003-2025): the trend is +0.03 mg/m3 per decade, about +0.06 mg/m3 over the whole period. It is NOT statistically significant: p = 0.245 >= 0.05. That does not prove there is no trend; the change is not distinguishable from year-to-year variability with this many years. A longer record or a larger region can make a real trend significant.

dataset.label: Ocean chlorophyll-a (MODIS Aqua)
dataset.source: MODIS Aqua L3 mapped chlorophyll-a monthly 9 km, R2022 (NASA OB.DAAC), averaged here to 0.25 deg
dataset.note: The amount of microscopic plant life (phytoplankton) at the sea surface. Each month is one 13 MB file, downloaded once and kept; the first run of a long period takes a few minutes. Aqua's orbit has drifted since 2022: recent trends need care
